name: sx/prose
title: SX Prose (page text)
description: Formats a service page's text: H2/H3, paragraphs, lists, a simple table. Optional table of contents. Content comes from the content pipeline.

guardrails: Only h2, h3, p, ul, ol, li, strong, em, a, table, blockquote survive; all attributes except href are removed.
Links: page:<id> for internal pages, https:// for sources. Brand links belong in CTAs, not in prose.
